name: Linear
author: Enplace
summary: Use a Linear team as a project's work.
description: Keeps a project's work in step with a Linear team's issues, so the work can live in Linear while you plan it here. Pick the team (and, if you like, one Linear project) from the teams your API key can see, and its open issues come in as one approval. After that it checks every five minutes for issues changed since the last sync: titles, descriptions, statuses, priorities, labels and due dates stay in step both ways, and estimates show as points on the item. Statuses land by their type (backlog and to do in To do, started in Doing, anything called review in review, completed and canceled in Done) unless you map them. New work you add here becomes an issue in the team. Sub-issues come in as plain work naming their parent, and agents can read an issue's latest comments.

settings.name: Linear API key
settings.help: A personal API key, from Linear: Settings › Security & access › Personal API keys. It's used for every project unless a project has its own.

settings.name: API key for this project
settings.help: Only if this project's team is in another Linear workspace, or needs another person's key. Blank uses the workspace's key.

settings.name: Add new work to Linear too
settings.help: New work you add to this project becomes an issue in the team (and the Linear project, if you picked one).

tools.name: get_linear_issue
tools.description: A work item's Linear issue: its identifier, link, status, assignee, parent, points and latest comments (up to 10), as of the last sync. Read-only.

params.name: work
params.description: The work item's key, like ENP-12.
